stages.method_description: SHA-256 exact hash: concatenate all message texts, compute SHA-256 digest, group samples with identical hashes. Duplicate reason: texts are character-for-character identical.
Character 3-gram overlap ratio: compute pairwise |A∩B|/min(|A|,|B|) for all surviving samples. Duplicate when ratio >= 0.70. Duplicate reason: high character n-gram overlap between texts.
MinHash LSH: 128 permutations, 16 bands × 8 rows. Candidate pairs from banding, verified with Jaccard >= 0.70. Duplicate reason: high estimated Jaccard similarity of character 3-gram sets.
